thread:
Marina (Partnerships): AcmeEdge wants seat changes in the hourly marketplace webhook so they can prorate mid-cycle. They prefer one stream. Risk: duplicate charges if we don't reconcile. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): We currently accept usage_units + sku_id only. Adding seat_snapshot or seat_delta is doable but needs idempotency and ordering guarantees.

Nina (Billing): Strong preference for an entitlement_sequence field. Proposal: require seat_snapshot (absolute int) + entitlement_sequence (monotonic int). If sequence <= last_applied_sequence ignore. That keeps ledger idempotent.

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge can emit a sequence and idempotency_key. They want credits applied immediately to avoid customer confusion.

Alex (SRE): We'll add a replay endpoint for partners to backfill missed sequences and a rate limit for entitlement events. Also surface metric partner.entitlement.sequence.skew.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Draft minimal payload:
`{"event_id":"evt-...","event_ts":"2026-03-20T12:34:56Z","customer_id":"cust-1","sku_id":"acme-seats","usage_units":800,"seat_snapshot":42,"entitlement_sequence":17,"idempotency_key":"acme-20260320-17"}`
Return ack: `{"status":"ok","last_applied_sequence":17}`.

Nina (Billing): Billing action items: implement sequence handling, compute prorate adjustments in cents (banker's rounding), and choose invoice-window cutoff for applying adjustments (current invoice if open, otherwise next). I'll draft RFC and loop in Legal for credit/refund phrasing.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Integrations will publish webhook v2, implement ack + replay endpoints, and add staging tests.

Marina (Partnerships): Timeline: aim for partner beta by end of next sprint to align with AcmeEdge announcement. I'll coordinate weekly.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-3421 for "Entitlement sequence + prorate support" and linked to this thread. :white_check_mark:
